title: Use of the moodle information and educational environment in the distance learning system for forming the physiological literacy of future coaches
reason: Compares cohort-level grade 'success' and 'quality' percentages across academic years and study forms; Moodle visits reported only in aggregate per resource, never per student or related to outcomes.
